title: Import Claude Code sub-agent transcripts as spawned sessions
description: Claude Code writes sub-agent sidechains at <project>/<session-id>/subagents/agent-<agentId>.jsonl with a sibling agent-<agentId>.meta.json (agentType, description, toolUseId, spawnDepth, model). Discovery currently looks for <project>/subagents (wrong place, counts 0) and skips them. Import each as its own session: parent_id = the owning session, subagent = SubagentInfo{kind: agentType, nesting_depth: spawnDepth}, spawn moment = the parent turn that issued toolUseId (or the sidechain's first timestamp). Timeline then nests them. Gherkin specs + synthetic fixtures; doctor counts updated.
